mentions.name: Human-writable data interchange format
mentions.description: A new data interchange format the author is inventing, deliberately incompatible with existing formats like JSON, offering no syntax typing, efficient encoding, and human writability.
mentions.problem: The author argues existing data interchange formats don't offer this combination of properties (no syntax typing, efficient encoding, human writable).
mentions.source_excerpt: The world didn’t have enough json variants. I’m doing my part and inventing a new data interchange format. Don’t worry though, it’s not compatible with any of the others.

evidence.value: The world didn’t have enough json variants. I’m doing my part and inventing a new data interchange format. Don’t worry though, it’s not compatible with any of the others.
